assertionSemantics.expected.concepts: English CANONICAL entity names (core_entities.name) that must appear in the grounded parse. Grounded set = every entityId in structuredRequest.entities, resolved back to its canonical name.
assertionSemantics.expected.excluded: Folded text that must appear as an excludedSpan (R5-3 negation record).
assertionSemantics.expected.mustNotResolve: Canonical names that must NEVER appear in the grounded set. A hit here is an INVERSION or a wrong-language grounding — the hard failures.
assertionSemantics.park: true = 'unresolved/park' is a CORRECT outcome for this query. Used for translation-bridge nouns with no corpus twin and for homographs where silence beats a confident wrong answer.

strataRules.single_noun: PASS iff every expected concept is grounded (or, when park=true, the query cleanly parked with nothing outside expected grounded).
strataRules.compound: Constraint preservation measured on the PARSE: PASS iff EVERY expected concept is present. Partial credit is reported separately as the ≥90% constraint-preservation number.
strataRules.negation: HARD, 100%: every expected.excluded text must be recorded in excludedSpans AND no mustNotResolve name may be grounded. Non-inversion is the assertion, not recall.
strataRules.attribute: PASS iff the expected attribute-type entity (food_attribute / restaurant_attribute) is grounded. Grounding the right word to a FOOD entity of the same name is scored as a type miss.
strataRules.homograph: SAFE-BEHAVIOR assertion, inverted from the others: PASS iff the grounded set is a SUBSET of expected.concepts (empty set = clean park = PASS). Any grounding outside the allowed set is a confident wrong-language mis-grounding = FAIL.
strataRules.code_switched: PASS iff the ENGLISH span's concept is grounded. Spanish carrier words are not asserted (they may junk-ground; that is the extraction-hygiene backlog, not i18n).
